**skull-elixir** is a project in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md). Its code is written mainly in [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md) (88.5 %), with [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 22 September 2016; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 5 December 2016. It reads “Math”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2016, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/skull-elixir) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/skull-elixir).

Related work in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md): [Test-Elixir](@/work/test-elixir.md) (2017), [rustler-test](@/work/rustler-test.md) (2017), [grache-test](@/work/grache-test.md) (2015) and [skull](@/work/skull.md) (2014).
